name: app-oviah-closing-thank-you-slide-with-3d-app-icon-tile
title: OVIAH closing 'Until we Meet again! Thank You!' slide with team-name pills and a glossy 3D app icon tile
whatItIs: A white slide with an italic 'Until we Meet again!' eyebrow, a huge navy 'Thank You!', four pink-outlined pills naming the team members, and on the right a glossy white 3D app-icon tile with the droplet logo and a small numbered badge, set against a purple blob.
whatItMeans: Warm and polished; the glossy icon tile turns a simple thank-you into a final piece of brand presentation.
techniques: Render the app icon as a glossy 3D tile for the closing slide.
List team members as individual pills rather than one line.
Keep the closing tone personal with a light, informal eyebrow line.

vocabulary.definition: An app icon rendered with depth and shading like a physical object.
A small line of text above a main headline.
